text:
Foods before: 2 slices of sourdough toast (~40g each, ~100 kcal each = 200 kcal, 80g), muffin (~60g, ~220 kcal), coffee with milk (latte-like, ~200 ml, ~80 kcal), 2 fried eggs (~100g, ~180 kcal), roasted tomato halves (~80g, 20 kcal), mushrooms (~40g, 10 kcal), butter portions (2 small, ~10g each; one is left in the after photo, with one butter apparently used/opened and the other unopened, so ~7g butter eaten = ~50 kcal).

After: the muffin is eaten (only wrapper left), eggs, tomato, and mushrooms are eaten (just a yellow smear remains), toast is eaten (crumbs), the coffee is mostly drunk (some residue), and the butter was opened but partly left; the jam (red packet) is unopened.

Eaten: toast 200, muffin 220, eggs 180, tomato 20, mushrooms 10, coffee ~75, butter ~30 (the open one is mostly still there, so a partial amount was eaten).

Total is about 735 kcal.

Mass: toast 80 + muffin 60 + eggs 100 + tomato 80 + mushrooms 40 + coffee 190 + butter 5 = 555 g.
